name: Shotlane
author: Shotlane
description: A real browser for your agent: screenshots, phone, tablet and desktop checks, pages as Markdown and HTML to PDF. Sign in with OAuth or an API key. 100 free renders a month.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot a web page
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a public web page and return it as an image you can look at. The user sees it in an inline viewer. Use it when the user asks for a screenshot or to see a page, including how it looks on a specific device such as an iPhone (set device), and for questions about how a page looks: layout or visual bugs, charts, images, or whether a deploy actually rendered. For page text, read_page returns Markdown. Uses 1 credit from the user's Shotlane account.

url.description: Page URL; https:// is assumed if omitted.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Tall pages come back as several image slices so text stays readable.

device.description: Show the page as on this device (screen size and mobile mode). Overrides width and height.

width.description: Viewport width in px (240-1920). Use 393 for a phone.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to capture a single element.

delay.description: Extra wait after load in ms (0-10000).

tools.name: html_to_pdf
tools.title: Render HTML or a page to PDF
tools.description: Render HTML, Markdown or a URL to a PDF in headless Chromium and return a download link. Uses 1 credit from the user's Shotlane account.

markdown.description: Alternatively, Markdown; rendered with a clean document style.

url.description: Alternatively, a public page URL to print.

margin.description: Page margin on all sides, e.g. 15mm or 0.5in. Default 0.

page_numbers.description: Add a '1 / N' page number footer.

tools.name: read_page
tools.title: Read a web page as Markdown
tools.description: Load a public web page in a real browser (JavaScript executed) and return its main content as clean Markdown, with title and metadata. Works on single-page apps and JavaScript-heavy sites. Uses 1 credit from the user's Shotlane account.

url.description: Page URL; https:// is assumed if omitted.

main_content.description: Extract only the main article/content (drops nav, footer, ads). Set false for the whole page.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector; convert only this element.

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extracting.

max_chars.description: Cut the Markdown after this many characters (default 100000).

tools.name: check_page
tools.title: Check a page on phone, tablet and desktop
tools.description: Check whether a public web page looks right on phone, tablet and desktop. Returns a screenshot per device plus what went wrong on each: sideways scrolling and the elements causing it, JavaScript errors, failed requests and broken images. Use it when the user asks whether a page looks right, works on mobile or has layout bugs, or after a deploy. To just see a page, including on one device, use screenshot instead. The user sees the images side by side in an inline viewer. Uses 1 credit per device.

url.description: Page URL; https:// is assumed if omitted.

full_page.description: Capture whole pages instead of the first screen.

tools.name: credits
tools.title: Check Shotlane credits
tools.description: Show how many Shotlane render credits remain on this account. Does not use credits.
